subject.title: [Bug]: Mattermost interaction token forgeable via hardcoded HMAC derivation key

question: What durable Mattermost interaction signing model should replace bot-token-derived HMAC secrets before this issue can be fixed?
rationale: The code fix changes the credential that gates Mattermost button callbacks, so maintainers need to choose between persisted/generated provisioning, explicit operator configuration, or a narrower fail-closed security posture before landing a PR.

options.title: Require durable secret provisioning
options.body: Make the replacement signing secret configured or persisted through supported setup, SecretRef, docs, and upgrade-test surfaces before merge.

options.title: Accept explicit fail-closed setup
options.body: Require operators to configure a new Mattermost interaction secret, with clear runtime errors, docs, and tests for the failure mode.

options.title: Pause for a replacement PR
options.body: Close or pause the conflicting candidate branch and sponsor a narrower replacement once the credential model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Require durable secret provisioning
recommendation.body: Make the replacement signing secret configured or persisted through supported setup, SecretRef, docs, and upgrade-test surfaces before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent merged work on the same Mattermost interaction callback surface and are a strong routing candidate for the security/compatibility tradeoff.
